directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired and renamed trillion-launch-video-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: compare-voice-and-music-models: the narration voice A/B take makers, take measure and A/B render move byte for byte from trillion-launch-video

preserve: pauses: every silence of 120 ms or more inside the speech (10 ms RMS below -45 dBFS) with the word heard before and after
words per second over the speech, and articulation rate over voiced time only, counted in script words
F0 5th-95th percentile and span in semitones, onset F2 and voiced length of the vowel_check word (Praat through parselmouth)
word errors: Levenshtein over normalised words of the script against what whisper heard; whisper word times written to <take>.words.json
same_voice: cosine of a WeSpeaker embedding to the line's voice_reference; accent: mean classifier probability over 5 s windows
allowed_deltas: every model, level and length is a setting over DEFAULTS; the accent key is p_<accent_label> (p_england by default)
the pause finder is pauses_of(y, sr, words, ...); --words-from measures with saved word times; --no-voice-models leaves the voice models out
the words go to the take's folder's work/ (or --words-dir) instead of the script's film folder; parselmouth's python is a setting (default /tmp/pm-venv when there, else this python)
a last {result}/{error} line follows the per-take lines
banned_substitutions: a second pause finder beside pauses_of
a different word-error measure than the word Levenshtein
_lines: The source is the file's lines named, in parts: the lines between them name the film's narrator and stay behind (their job is the line data and settings now).
